title: 1.5 Formulae and variations: subject of a formula, direct, inverse, joint and partial variation

q.Q1: Q1. Make r the subject of V = πr²h.
q.Q2: Q2. Make x the subject of y = (x + 2)/(x − 3).

q.Q3: Q3. y varies directly as x². When x = 3, y = 36. Find y when x = 5.
q.Q4: Q4. Six workers harvest a field in 10 days. How long would 15 workers take at the same rate?

q.Q5: Q5. A varies directly as B and inversely as C. A = 6 when B = 4 and C = 2. Find A when B = 10 and C = 5.

q.Q6: Q6. A taxi fare F is partly constant and partly varies with distance d. A 4 km trip costs KSh 500 and a 10 km trip costs KSh 950. Find the fare for 7 km.

q.Q7: Q7. Values: x = 1, 2, 4, 8 give y = 16, 8, 4, 2. State the type of variation, find the formula and find y when x = 32.
